verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמ֑וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־ תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ĕ·lō·hê ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî ’al- te·ḥĕ·raš
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David O God of my praise be not silent

verses.original: כִּ֤י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־ מִ֭רְמָה פִ֪י פָּתָ֑חוּ עָלַ֣י דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י שָֽׁקֶר׃ לְשׁ֣וֹן
verses.transliteration: kî rā·šā‘ ū·p̄î- mir·māh p̄î pā·ṯā·ḥū ‘ā·lay dib·bə·rū ’it·tî šā·qer lə·šō·wn
verses.literal: For wicked . . . and deceitful mouths open against me they speak against me with lying tongues

verses.original: סְבָב֑וּנִי שִׂנְאָ֣ה וְדִבְרֵ֣י וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî śin·’āh wə·ḏiḇ·rê way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū·nî ḥin·nām
verses.literal: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־ אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ- ’a·hă·ḇā·ṯî yiś·ṭə·nū·nî wa·’ă·nî ṯə·p̄il·lāh
verses.literal: In return for my love they accuse me but I [am a man] [of] prayer

verses.original: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū ‘ā·lay rā·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh wə·śin·’āh ta·ḥaṯ ’a·hă·ḇā·ṯî
verses.literal: They repay me . . . evil for good and hatred for my love

verses.original: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־ יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hap̄·qêḏ ‘ā·lāw rā·šā‘ wə·śā·ṭān ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- yə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: Set over him a wicked man let an accuser stand at his right hand

verses.original: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·hiš·šā·p̄ə·ṭōw yê·ṣê rā·šā‘ ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯōw tih·yeh la·ḥă·ṭā·’āh
verses.literal: When he is tried . . . let him be found guilty and may his prayer be regarded as sin

verses.original: יָמָ֥יו יִֽהְיֽוּ־ מְעַטִּ֑ים אַחֵֽר׃ יִקַּ֥ח פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: yā·māw yih·yū- mə·‘aṭ·ṭîm ’a·ḥêr yiq·qaḥ pə·qud·dā·ṯōw
verses.literal: May his days be few may another take his position

verses.original: בָנָ֥יו יִֽהְיוּ־ יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw yih·yū- yə·ṯō·w·mîm wə·’iš·tōw ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow

verses.original: בָנָ֣יו וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw wə·nō·w·a‘ yā·nū·‘ū wə·ši·’ê·lū wə·ḏā·rə·šū mê·ḥā·rə·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: May his children wander . . . as beggars seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes

verses.original: נ֭וֹשֶׁה יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ לְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ זָרִ֣ים וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ יְגִיעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·wō·šeh yə·naq·qêš lə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw zā·rîm wə·yā·ḇōz·zū yə·ḡî·‘ōw
verses.literal: May the creditor seize all - he owns and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor

verses.original: יְהִ֥י וְֽאַל־ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד ל֭וֹ יְהִי־ אַל־ ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî wə·’al- mō·šêḵ ḥā·seḏ lōw yə·hî- ’al- ḥō·w·nên lî·ṯō·w·māw
verses.literal: May there be no one to extend kindness to him [and] no one to favor his fatherless children

verses.original: אַחֲרִית֥וֹ יְהִֽי־ לְהַכְרִ֑ית שְׁמָֽם׃ יִמַּ֥ח אַ֝חֵ֗ר בְּד֥וֹר
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw yə·hî- lə·haḵ·rîṯ šə·mām yim·maḥ ’a·ḥêr bə·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: May his descendants be cut off may their name be blotted out from the next generation

verses.original: עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו יִזָּכֵ֤ר׀ אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־ תִּמָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·wōn ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw yiz·zā·ḵêr ’el- Yah·weh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ ’im·mōw ’al- tim·māḥ
verses.literal: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD and the sin of his mother never be blotted out

verses.original: תָּמִ֑יד יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד־ יְהוָ֣ה וְיַכְרֵ֖ת זִכְרָֽם׃ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ
verses.transliteration: tā·mîḏ yih·yū ne·ḡeḏ- Yah·weh wə·yaḵ·rêṯ ziḵ·rām mê·’e·reṣ
verses.literal: May [their sins] always remain before the LORD that He may cut off their memory from the earth

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־ עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer lō zā·ḵar ‘ă·śō·wṯ ḥā·seḏ way·yir·dōp̄ ’îš- ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn wə·niḵ·’êh lê·ḇāḇ lə·mō·w·ṯêṯ
verses.literal: For - he never thought to show kindness but pursued . . . the poor and needy and brokenhearted even to their death

verses.original: קְ֭לָלָה וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וְֽלֹא־ חָפֵ֥ץ וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qə·lā·lāh way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ wat·tə·ḇō·w·’ê·hū biḇ·rā·ḵāh wə·lō- ḥā·p̄êṣ wat·tir·ḥaq mim·men·nū
verses.literal: The cursing [that] he loved may it fall on him the blessing [in which] he refused to delight may it be far from him

verses.original: קְלָלָ֗ה וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ כַמַּ֣יִם בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן
verses.transliteration: qə·lā·lāh way·yil·baš kə·mad·dōw wat·tā·ḇō bə·qir·bōw ḵam·ma·yim bə·‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw wə·ḵaš·še·men
verses.literal: The cursing [that] he wore like a coat may it soak into his body like water and into his bones like oil

verses.original: תְּהִי־ ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃ תָּמִ֥יד
verses.transliteration: tə·hî- lōw kə·ḇe·ḡeḏ ya‘·ṭeh ū·lə·mê·zaḥ yaḥ·gə·re·hā tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: May it be like a robe wrapped about him like a belt tied forever around him

verses.original: זֹ֤את יְהוָ֑ה פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ Yah·weh pə·‘ul·laṯ śō·ṭə·nai mê·’êṯ wə·had·dō·ḇə·rîm rā‘ ‘al- nap̄·šî
verses.literal: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers . . . to those who speak evil against me

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה׀ יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲ‍ֽשֵׂה־ אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃ כִּי־ ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ‘ăśêh- ’it·tî lə·ma·‘an šə·me·ḵā haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî kî- ṭō·wḇ ḥas·də·ḵā
verses.literal: But You O GOD the Lord deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָנֹ֑כִי עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn wə·lib·bî ḥā·lal bə·qir·bî
verses.literal: For I [am] poor and needy my heart is wounded within me

verses.original: נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ כְּצֵל־ נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ne·hĕ·lā·ḵə·tî kin·ṭō·w·ṯōw kə·ṣêl- nin·‘ar·tî kā·’ar·beh
verses.literal: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow I am shaken off like a locust

verses.original: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: bir·kay kā·šə·lū miṣ·ṣō·wm ū·ḇə·śā·rî kā·ḥaš miš·šā·men
verses.literal: My knees are weak from fasting and my body grows lean and gaunt

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî ḥer·pāh lā·hem yir·’ū·nî yə·nî·‘ūn rō·šām
verses.literal: I am an object of scorn to [my accusers] when they see me they shake their heads

verses.original: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·zə·rê·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ḵə·ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Help me O LORD my God save me according to Your loving devotion

verses.original: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־ יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū kî- yā·ḏə·ḵā zōṯ ’at·tāh Yah·weh ‘ă·śî·ṯāh
verses.literal: Let them know that this [is] Your hand that You O LORD have done it

verses.original: הֵמָּה֮ יְקַֽלְלוּ־ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ׀ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yə·qal·lū- wə·’at·tāh ṯə·ḇā·rêḵ qā·mū way·yê·ḇō·šū wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā yiś·māḥ
verses.literal: Though they curse You will bless When they rise up they will be put to shame but Your servant will rejoice

verses.original: שׂוֹטְנַ֣י יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃ כַמְעִ֣יל
verses.transliteration: śō·wṭ·nay yil·bə·šū kə·lim·māh wə·ya·‘ă·ṭū bā·šə·tām ḵam·‘îl
verses.literal: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace may they wear their shame like a robe

verses.original: בְּפִ֑י א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃ וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄î ’ō·w·ḏeh Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ’ă·hal·len·nū ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ rab·bîm
verses.literal: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely I will praise Him in the presence of many

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ya·‘ă·mōḏ lî·mîn ’eḇ·yō·wn lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ miš·šō·p̄ə·ṭê nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one to save him from the condemners of his soul
